text:
zara: Morning — EU ingest again produced a wave of 2-3h-late events between 03:10-04:00 UTC. Recompute queue is spiking and we're starting to see token-tail latency on shared pools. Thinking we need a graceful-degrade flow so backfills don't thrash the serving SLOs. cc @eugene @priya

eugene: Can you paste a sample log? want to confirm late vs dupes. If it's late arrival we can bias routing; if duplicates we should dedupe upstream.

zara: snippet from ingest (keys redacted):
```
INGEST: region=eu shard=eu-3 hour=2026-03-10T03:00Z lag_sec=7200 events=1430 status=arrived
REPLAY-SCHED: enqueue id=rb-20260310-77 tenant=delta-corp window=1h reason=late-ingest
```
not seeing a huge duplicate pattern in samples, mostly legitimately late arrival.

priya: We should avoid blanket re-routing. Proposal: 1) add `routing.qos_hint` to replay API (values: low_cost, low_latency, default) 2) scheduler will map low_cost -> spot/spot-dedicated, low_latency -> reserved/dedicated, default -> shared.

dexter: For immediate relief we can add an operator level throttle: if shared_pool_token_pressure > 70% then scheduler rejects low_cost and routes low_latency only if quota available. That buys us headroom.

ops: Agree. Also need telemetry tags so we can tell the difference in dashboards: `replay.qos` (low_cost|low_latency|default) and `replay.routing.pool` (shared|dedicated|spot). Will update alerting panels to separate shared vs reserved SLOs.

telemetry-bot: NOTE: please tag replay metrics with replay.qos and replay.routing.pool. Also emit replay.precheck.dedupe_rate when precheck enabled.

eugene: Architecturally: add `routing.qos_hint` field to internal create endpoint; example: `{"tenant":"delta-corp","window":"1h","routing.qos_hint":"low_cost"}`. Scheduler will honor if capacity exists and falls back with a `suggested_fallback` in response.

zara: UX ask: Lina, can we show a small badge in the targeted-replay modal: "Routing preference: [Low-cost]" with a tooltip that explains fallbacks and cost/wait estimate? Ops wants a visible 'request quota' CTA if the user picks low-latency but lacks reserved slots.

lina: Yep. I'll add a compact toggle group with three options. Console will call scheduler preflight (`/replays/preflight`) to get `cost_estimate` and `suggested_fallback`. Example preflight response expected: `{accepted:true, pool:d edicated, cost:"$12.30", wait_ms:120000}` or `{accepted:false, suggested_fallback:"shared", estimated_wait:300000}`.

priya: Important: do not let `low_cost` bypass billing or telemetry. Always tag with `meta.routing_hint=true` and emit a stable billing token count.

dexter: Safety net: admission-rule: if shared_pool_p95_api_latency > baseline*2 then block new background/low_cost admissions and return `suggested_fallback:passive`. Implement a circuit breaker metric that flips on/off.

zara: For fast mitigation: can we enable `routing.qos_hint` parsing in scheduler behind ff and enable a one-tenant canary to try low_cost routing to spot-dedicated? ops can open quota ticket for a short window.

ops: Please run `rb-tool quota request --tenant delta-corp --pool spot-dedicated-eu --tokens 1000000 --hours 2` and include this thread. We'll prioritize triage. Also we'll monitor SLOs and set alert thresholds.

telemetry-bot: Canary job created: rb-20260310-77 tenant=delta-corp qos=low_cost pool=spot-dedicated estimated_tokens=1.0M

eugene: One more ask: scheduler should return `admission_reason` and `downgrade_reason` fields for audit so we can find why jobs were downgraded (quota, admission_budget, circuit-breaker).

priya: Also implement a tiny pre-enqueue dedupe pass for late arrivals when `precheck.dedupe=true`. If skip_rate > 20% we can auto-expand background budget safely. Make this default-off for now.

dexter: Ops safety: add an auto-throttle that reduces background admission rate by 50% when shared queue depth > 5k or reserved tokens > 80% used. We'll log actions to `replay.admission.actions`.

lina: UX small point: show the scheduler preflight result inline so users see "Assigned to spot-dedicated (may be preempted). Estimated cost: $8. Wait: ~3-5min" or the downgrade pill if it fell back.

zara: Plan summary: 1) add `routing.qos_hint` + `precheck.dedupe` to internal API behind FF; 2) scheduler returns preflight + suggested_fallback + admission_reason; 3) console shows toggle + preflight results with CTA for quota; 4) ops request quota and run 2h canary for delta-corp; 5) monitor p95, shared queue depth, dedupe_rate, token burn. If any SLO regression revert FF.

eugene: I'll open the scheduler PR and add the circuit-breaker logic. priya, can you own telemetry tags?

priya: Yep. I'll add `replay.qos`, `replay.routing.pool`, `replay.precheck.dedupe_rate`, and `replay.admission.actions` to the metrics pipeline and update dashboards.

ops: Quota ticket created. We'll watch the canary window. If rollback needed, ping #eng-oncall and include thread link.

zara: Canary started 04:00 UTC — posting results here once we have them. Thanks all :rocket:
